Hello, I have problem in my room. The air conditioning is not work and is very hot.
Oh, I am sorry about the heat. Can you tell me your room number?
Yes, sorry, my room is number two hundred twelve. I can not sleep because is too hot and I am very tired.
I am sorry you cannot sleep. What would help you?
Maybe I can change to other room? Or somebody can come and repair the air conditioning now, please?
Yes, someone can come in ten minutes. Is anything else wrong in your room?
Ten minutes is okay, thank you. Also the bathroom, the water is not hot in shower. Sorry.
Thank you. Do you want a new room tonight?
No, thank you. I stay in this room if the air conditioning is working. Sorry, and thank you for help.
Okay, you can stay in room two hundred twelve. How is the room now, while you wait?

criteria.evidence: Level set to A2 by fixture; no placement in this journey.
#2 'How can I help you tonight?' and the cues ('Name one problem in your room') are plain A2.
Petra never asked for a repeat or said she didn't understand.
#1 six plan topics are all hotel/work/parent: 'My hotel booking is missing', 'Call the travel agency', 'Talk with my child's teacher'.
#3 'The air conditioning is not working' is correct and usable at a desk, though only one phrase was given.
#1 topic list and all scene lines are child-safe; nothing to worry a parent.

done.evidence: #2–#7 five spoken replies from the plan topic 'Problem with my hotel room', kept going.
Ana's lines are short and A2, e.g. #6 'Yes, someone can come in ten minutes. Is anything else wrong in your room?'
#3 one moment, correct 'not working'; 1 in 5 turns, scene not broken up.
#9 recap: '5 spoken · 0 written replies · 5 on your own · 1 moment to keep' and the fix repeated.

judgeAgreement.disagreements: No placement tasks in this journey.

boundaries.notes: Nothing adult, no personal data request, no humiliating line.

findings.title: Several clear errors got no coaching
findings.expected: 'I have problem', 'because is too hot', 'water is not hot in shower' noted in the recap
findings.got: Only 'not work' became a moment; the recap lists one fix
findings.evidence: #2 'I have problem'; #4 'because is too hot'; #6 'the water is not hot in shower'; #9 '1 moment to keep'
findings.suggested_acceptance: With as-needed correction, recap lists the main recurring slip (missing article/subject 'is') even if the scene is not stopped.

findings.title: Patient, realistic A2 front-desk partner
findings.got: Ana speaks short supportive lines; all 6 at band
findings.evidence: #4 'Oh, I am sorry about the heat. Can you tell me your room number?'

findings.title: Moment is correct and brief
findings.got: 'not working' with a one-line reason, then back to the scene

judge.voice: I would use it again. Ana was patient and spoke slowly, like a real guest conversation, and the air-conditioning problem is exactly what happens at my desk. The one correction, "not working", was right and I can say it tomorrow. I did not feel tested. But I made more mistakes than that, like "I have problem" and "because is too hot", and nobody told me. The recap showed only one thing to keep, so I do not fully trust that I am learning everything. As a mother I looked at the topic list and saw nothing wrong for Tomáš or Klára, which is what I needed. Fifteen minutes after the kids sleep is better than an evening course and a babysitter. I would tell a colleague, but I would want a few more corrections.

prior.evidence: #4 'because is too hot' and #6 'the water is not hot in shower' passed with no moment.
#9 '1 moment to keep' while #2 'I have problem' and #4 'because is too hot' got none.
#7 'Mission done' came after four replies and Ana stayed on the room: #8 'How is the room now, while you wait?'
